name: yf_trending_tickers
description:
Most actively traded US stocks from Yahoo Finance's most_actives screen, through yfinance's Screener class. Takes no inputs.
Returns: {trending: up to 20 Yahoo quote objects} or {error}.
yfinance 0.2.66 (the version installed with SAJHA at the time of writing) no longer has yf.Screener, so this returns {error}; openbb_equity_discovery_active (provider yfinance) gives the same list. No API key; data comes from Yahoo Finance through the yfinance library.
Example: {}
